_meta.title: Narrative Boundary — Machine-Generated Fixture Outputs
_meta.finding: FY Mar-26 revenue: IC memo £194m vs model £184.4m
_meta.description: Six representative fixture outputs produced by F05 production functions. Used for deterministic acceptance verification without requiring a live pipeline run.

fixture_1_locked_narration_input._description: LockedNarrationInput built from the SCG £194m revenue canonical finding. This is the ONLY input provided to the LLM for narration. No authoritative fields may be reconstructed from LLM output.
fixture_1_locked_narration_input.exact_claim_text: Management projects FY Mar-26 revenue of £194m for the group

fixture_2_valid_narrative_validation_pas._description: A narrative that correctly references only canonical values (£194m, £184.4m, -4.95%) and uses the correct admitted source. validateNarrativeOutput() must return passed: true.

narrative_input.title: Revenue Projection Variance
narrative_input.summary: The IC memo states £194m of FY Mar-26 revenue. The current model records £184.4m at P&L/B12, a £9.6m difference.
narrative_input.explanation: The IC memo projects group revenue of £194m for FY Mar-26. The current financial model (SCG_Financial_Model_v3.xlsx) shows £184,391,535 in cell B12 of the P&L sheet. This represents a shortfall of approximately £9.6m (−4.95%). The deterministic verdict is contradicted.

fixture_3_rejected_narrative_invented_nu._description: A narrative that invents a value (£195m) not present in all_canonical_numbers. validateNarrativeOutput() must return passed: false with RULE_1_INVENTED_NUMERIC.

narrative_input.title: Revenue Projection Variance
narrative_input.summary: The IC memo states £195m of revenue, while the model shows £180m.
narrative_input.explanation: The revenue projection has a variance of approximately 12.3% below expectations.

fixture_4_rejected_narrative_verdict_con._description: A narrative that asserts 'confirms' against a deterministic_verdict of 'contradicted'. validateNarrativeOutput() must return passed: false with RULE_7_VERDICT_CONTRADICTION.

narrative_input.title: Revenue Confirmed
narrative_input.summary: The model confirms the IC memo revenue of £194m.
narrative_input.explanation: After analysis, the figure is confirmed by the current financial model.

fixture_5_deterministic_fallback_narrati._description: Output of generateDeterministicFallbackNarrative() for the SCG £194m finding. Must include canonical claim value, must reference 'contradicted' verdict, must pass its own validateNarrativeOutput() check.

representative_sample.title: Revenue Projection Variance
representative_sample.summary: The IC memo states FY Mar-26 revenue of £194m for the group. The admitted evidence (SCG_Financial_Model_v3.xlsx) records £184,391,535, a signed delta of −£9,608,465 (−4.95%). The deterministic verdict is contradicted.
representative_sample.explanation: Canonical finding: SCG revenue for FY Mar-26. The IC memo states: Management projects FY Mar-26 revenue of £194m for the group. Admitted evidence: SCG_Financial_Model_v3.xlsx — coordinate P&L/B12 — £184,391,535 GBP [contradicting]. Calculation: claim £194,000,000 vs fact £184,391,535, delta −£9,608,465 (−4.95%), direction claim_higher. Deterministic verdict: contradicted. Disposition reason: numeric_divergence_above_threshold. This narrative was generated deterministically from canonical facts.

fixture_6_authority_gate_verified_demoti._description: applyAuthorityGate() applied to a finding where the LLM has set evidence.verified=true without a canonical record (conservative: verdict treated as unverifiable). Gate must demote verified to false.

fixture_7_process_object_exclusion._description: shouldExcludeAsProcessObject() applied to 5 operational/diagnostic objects. All 5 must return true (excluded). A substantive finding must return false.
